title: Payment Arrangements Policy — Broken Plans and Reinstatement
content:
## 1. When a plan breaks

A plan under Payment Arrangements is broken on the day its uncured missed installments reach the type's breakage count, and the account returns from arranged to active. The uncured missed installments are the missed entries on the plan, over its whole life, whose installment has not since been paid in full (within the type's partial-payment tolerance).

## 2. Conditions for reinstatement

A broken plan may be reinstated only where the type's cure requirement is not "not reinstatable", only while its reinstatement count is below the type's largest number of reinstatements, and only once the cure is paid:

- "all missed installments" requires every missed installment to be paid in full;
- "one installment" requires one full regular installment paid after the break.

A broken plan is reinstated only when the handling date is no later than the last day of the reinstatement window counted from the plan's broken date. The reinstatement window is the type's reinstatement window figure in calendar days, the day after the broken date being day one and the last day included. The broken date and the reinstatement count are read from the plan record.

## 3. Effect of reinstatement

On reinstatement the remaining installments keep their original due dates, any installment whose due date has passed in the meantime and is not paid counts as missed again, and the account returns to arranged.

## 4. Plans not reinstated

A broken plan that is not reinstated by the end of the window, or whose type is not reinstatable, is cancelled with the close reason "broken, not reinstated" on the first day after the window, and its remaining arrangement balance is released while staying owed on the account.

## Conditions for reinstatement at a glance

| Condition | Must hold for reinstatement |
|---|---|
| The type's cure requirement is not "not reinstatable" | Yes |
| The reinstatement count is below the type's maximum | Yes |
| The cure for the type is paid | Yes |
| The handling date is no later than the last day of the window | Yes |

## Window boundary (hypothetical dates)

A plan broke on 1 May under a type whose window is 15 calendar days. Day one is 2 May and the last day is 16 May. On 16 May the plan may be reinstated (the other conditions holding); on 17 May, the first day after the window, a plan not reinstated is cancelled as "broken, not reinstated".

## Hypothetical breakage count

On a type whose breakage count is 2, a plan with one uncured missed installment is not broken; when a second missed installment is recorded while the first is still unpaid, the plan breaks that day. If the first had been paid in full before the second was missed, only one uncured miss would stand.
